import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Dot product of a coefficient row with an assignment (only overlapping
positions contribute; missing coefficients count as `0`). -/
def gf2dot : List Nat → List Nat → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [] => 0
  | a :: as, x :: xs => a * x + gf2dot as xs

/-- An equation `(coeffs, rhs)` list is satisfied by `x` when every equation
holds modulo 2. -/
def gf2sat (eqs : List (List Nat × Nat)) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ eqs, gf2dot e.1 x % 2 = e.2 % 2

/-- Row addition over GF(2) (XOR of coefficient vectors). -/
def gf2addRow : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], bs => bs
  | a :: as, [] => a :: as
  | a :: as, b :: bs => (a + b) % 2 :: gf2addRow as bs

/-- One elimination step: add the pivot equation `p` to `e` when `e` has an odd
leading coefficient, clearing that coefficient. -/
def gf2elim (p e : List Nat × Nat) : List Nat × Nat :=
  if e.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1 then (gf2addRow e.1 p.1, (e.2 + p.2) % 2) else e

/-- Gaussian elimination over GF(2), column by column.  `n` is the number of
remaining variables.  We look for a pivot row with an odd leading coefficient,
clear that column in all rows, drop the column, solve the smaller system
recursively and then back-substitute the pivot variable. -/
def gf2go : Nat → List (List Nat × Nat) → Option (List Nat)
  | 0, eqs => if eqs.all (fun e => e.2 % 2 == 0) then some [] else none
  | n + 1, eqs =>
    match eqs.find? (fun e => e.1.headD 0 % 2 == 1) with
    | none =>
      (gf2go n (eqs.map (fun e => (e.1.tail, e.2)))).map (fun xs => 0 :: xs)
    | some p =>
      (gf2go n ((eqs.map (gf2elim p)).map (fun e => (e.1.tail, e.2)))).map
        (fun xs => (p.2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs) % 2 :: xs)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  gf2go (matrix.getD 0 []).length (matrix.zip b)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem gf2dot_nil_left (x : List Nat) : gf2dot [] x = 0 := by
  cases x <;> rfl

theorem gf2dot_nil_right (l : List Nat) : gf2dot l [] = 0 := by
  cases l <;> rfl

theorem gf2getD_zero (l : List Nat) (d : Nat) : l.getD 0 d = l.headD d := by
  cases l <;> rfl

theorem gf2getD_succ (l : List Nat) (j d : Nat) : l.getD (j + 1) d = l.tail.getD j d := by
  cases l <;> rfl

theorem gf2dot_cons (l : List Nat) (x0 : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    gf2dot l (x0 :: xs) = l.headD 0 * x0 + gf2dot l.tail xs := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [gf2dot_nil_left]
  | cons a as => simp [gf2dot]

theorem gf2addRow_dot (as bs x : List Nat) :
    gf2dot (gf2addRow as bs) x % 2 = (gf2dot as x + gf2dot bs x) % 2 := by
  induction as generalizing bs x with
  | nil => simp [gf2addRow, gf2dot_nil_left]
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [gf2addRow, gf2dot_nil_left]
    | cons b bs =>
      cases x with
      | nil => simp [gf2dot_nil_right]
      | cons x0 xs =>
        show (((a + b) % 2) * x0 + gf2dot (gf2addRow as bs) xs) % 2
            = (a * x0 + gf2dot as xs + (b * x0 + gf2dot bs xs)) % 2
        have h1 : ((a + b) % 2) * x0 ≡ (a + b) * x0 [MOD 2] :=
          Nat.ModEq.mul_right x0 (Nat.mod_modEq (a + b) 2)
        have h2 : gf2dot (gf2addRow as bs) xs ≡ gf2dot as xs + gf2dot bs xs [MOD 2] := ih bs xs
        have h3 := Nat.ModEq.add h1 h2
        have h4 : (a + b) * x0 + (gf2dot as xs + gf2dot bs xs)
            = a * x0 + gf2dot as xs + (b * x0 + gf2dot bs xs) := by ring
        rw [h4] at h3
        exact h3

theorem gf2addRow_head (as bs : List Nat) (ha : as.headD 0 % 2 = 1)
    (hb : bs.headD 0 % 2 = 1) : (gf2addRow as bs).headD 0 % 2 = 0 := by
  cases as with
  | nil => simp at ha
  | cons a as =>
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp at hb
    | cons b bs =>
      simp only [gf2addRow, List.headD_cons] at *
      omega

theorem gf2elim_pos (p e : List Nat × Nat) (h : e.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1) :
    gf2elim p e = (gf2addRow e.1 p.1, (e.2 + p.2) % 2) := by
  simp [gf2elim, h]

theorem gf2elim_neg (p e : List Nat × Nat) (h : ¬ e.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1) :
    gf2elim p e = e := by
  simp [gf2elim, h]

theorem gf2elim_head (p e : List Nat × Nat) (hp : p.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1) :
    (gf2elim p e).1.headD 0 % 2 = 0 := by
  by_cases hh : e.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1
  · rw [gf2elim_pos p e hh]
    exact gf2addRow_head _ _ hh hp
  · rw [gf2elim_neg p e hh]
    omega

/-- When every equation has an even leading coefficient, the first variable is
irrelevant, so satisfaction is equivalent to satisfaction of the system with
the first column removed. -/
theorem gf2sat_tail_iff (eqs : List (List Nat × Nat))
    (h : ∀ e ∈ eqs, e.1.headD 0 % 2 = 0) (x0 : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    gf2sat eqs (x0 :: xs) ↔ gf2sat (eqs.map (fun e => (e.1.tail, e.2))) xs := by
  constructor
  · intro hs e he
    simp only [List.mem_map] at he
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := he
    have h1 := hs f hf
    have h2 : f.1.headD 0 * x0 % 2 = 0 := by
      rw [Nat.mul_mod, h f hf]; simp
    rw [gf2dot_cons, Nat.add_mod, h2] at h1
    simpa using h1
  · intro hs e he
    have h1 := hs (e.1.tail, e.2) (List.mem_map_of_mem he)
    have h2 : e.1.headD 0 * x0 % 2 = 0 := by
      rw [Nat.mul_mod, h e he]; simp
    rw [gf2dot_cons, Nat.add_mod, h2]
    simpa using h1

theorem gf2sat_elim (p : List Nat × Nat) (eqs : List (List Nat × Nat)) (x : List Nat)
    (hp : gf2dot p.1 x % 2 = p.2 % 2) (hs : gf2sat eqs x) :
    gf2sat (eqs.map (gf2elim p)) x := by
  intro e he
  simp only [List.mem_map] at he
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := he
  by_cases hh : f.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1
  · rw [gf2elim_pos p f hh]
    have key : gf2dot (gf2addRow f.1 p.1) x ≡ (f.2 + p.2) % 2 [MOD 2] :=
      calc gf2dot (gf2addRow f.1 p.1) x
          ≡ gf2dot f.1 x + gf2dot p.1 x [MOD 2] := gf2addRow_dot f.1 p.1 x
        _ ≡ f.2 + p.2 [MOD 2] := Nat.ModEq.add (hs f hf) hp
        _ ≡ (f.2 + p.2) % 2 [MOD 2] := (Nat.mod_modEq _ 2).symm
    exact key
  · rw [gf2elim_neg p f hh]
    exact hs f hf

theorem gf2sat_of_elim (p : List Nat × Nat) (eqs : List (List Nat × Nat)) (x : List Nat)
    (hp : gf2dot p.1 x % 2 = p.2 % 2) (hs : gf2sat (eqs.map (gf2elim p)) x) :
    gf2sat eqs x := by
  intro f hf
  have h1 := hs (gf2elim p f) (List.mem_map_of_mem hf)
  by_cases hh : f.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1
  · rw [gf2elim_pos p f hh] at h1
    have key : gf2dot f.1 x + p.2 ≡ f.2 + p.2 [MOD 2] :=
      calc gf2dot f.1 x + p.2
          ≡ gf2dot f.1 x + gf2dot p.1 x [MOD 2] := Nat.ModEq.add_left _ hp.symm
        _ ≡ gf2dot (gf2addRow f.1 p.1) x [MOD 2] := (gf2addRow_dot f.1 p.1 x).symm
        _ ≡ (f.2 + p.2) % 2 [MOD 2] := h1
        _ ≡ f.2 + p.2 [MOD 2] := Nat.mod_modEq _ 2
    exact Nat.ModEq.add_right_cancel' p.2 key
  · rw [gf2elim_neg p f hh] at h1
    exact h1

theorem gf2go_spec : ∀ (n : Nat) (eqs : List (List Nat × Nat)),
    match gf2go n eqs with
    | some x => x.length = n ∧ gf2sat eqs x
    | none => ∀ x : List Nat, x.length = n → ¬ gf2sat eqs x := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro eqs
    rw [gf2go]
    by_cases h : eqs.all (fun e => e.2 % 2 == 0) = true
    · rw [if_pos h]
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      intro e he
      have h2 := (List.all_eq_true.mp h) e he
      simp only [beq_iff_eq] at h2
      rw [gf2dot_nil_right, h2]
    · rw [if_neg h]
      intro x hx hsat
      rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at hx
      subst hx
      simp only [List.all_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, not_forall] at h
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨he1, he2⟩ := not_imp.mp he
      have h3 := hsat e he1
      rw [gf2dot_nil_right] at h3
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro eqs
    rw [gf2go]
    cases hfind : eqs.find? (fun e => e.1.headD 0 % 2 == 1) with
    | none =>
      have hall : ∀ e ∈ eqs, e.1.headD 0 % 2 = 0 := by
        intro e he
        have h2 := List.find?_eq_none.mp hfind e he
        simp only [beq_iff_eq] at h2
        omega
      have hrec := ih (eqs.map (fun e => (e.1.tail, e.2)))
      cases hgo : gf2go n (eqs.map (fun e => (e.1.tail, e.2))) with
      | none =>
        rw [hgo] at hrec
        simp only [Option.map_none]
        intro x hx hsat
        cases x with
        | nil => simp at hx
        | cons x0 xs =>
          exact hrec xs (by simpa using hx) ((gf2sat_tail_iff eqs hall x0 xs).mp hsat)
      | some xs =>
        rw [hgo] at hrec
        obtain ⟨hlen, hs⟩ := hrec
        simp only [Option.map_some]
        exact ⟨by simp [hlen], (gf2sat_tail_iff eqs hall 0 xs).mpr hs⟩
    | some p =>
      have hp1 : p.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1 := by
        have h2 := List.find?_some hfind
        simpa using h2
      have hpmem : p ∈ eqs := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfind
      have hheads : ∀ e ∈ eqs.map (gf2elim p), e.1.headD 0 % 2 = 0 := by
        intro e he
        simp only [List.mem_map] at he
        obtain ⟨f, _, rfl⟩ := he
        exact gf2elim_head p f hp1
      have hrec := ih ((eqs.map (gf2elim p)).map (fun e => (e.1.tail, e.2)))
      cases hgo : gf2go n ((eqs.map (gf2elim p)).map (fun e => (e.1.tail, e.2))) with
      | none =>
        rw [hgo] at hrec
        simp only [Option.map_none]
        intro x hx hsat
        cases x with
        | nil => simp at hx
        | cons x0 xs =>
          refine hrec xs (by simpa using hx) ?_
          exact (gf2sat_tail_iff _ hheads x0 xs).mp
            (gf2sat_elim p eqs _ (hsat p hpmem) hsat)
      | some xs =>
        rw [hgo] at hrec
        obtain ⟨hlen, hs⟩ := hrec
        simp only [Option.map_some]
        refine ⟨by simp [hlen], ?_⟩
        have hsat2 : gf2sat (eqs.map (gf2elim p)) ((p.2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs) % 2 :: xs) :=
          (gf2sat_tail_iff _ hheads _ xs).mpr hs
        have hpsat : gf2dot p.1 ((p.2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs) % 2 :: xs) % 2 = p.2 % 2 := by
          rw [gf2dot_cons]
          have hm : p.1.headD 0 ≡ 1 [MOD 2] := by
            show p.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1 % 2
            omega
          have key : p.1.headD 0 * ((p.2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs) % 2) + gf2dot p.1.tail xs
              ≡ p.2 [MOD 2] :=
            calc p.1.headD 0 * ((p.2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs) % 2) + gf2dot p.1.tail xs
                ≡ 1 * ((p.2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs) % 2) + gf2dot p.1.tail xs [MOD 2] :=
                  Nat.ModEq.add_right _ (Nat.ModEq.mul_right _ hm)
              _ = (p.2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs) % 2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs := by rw [one_mul]
              _ ≡ (p.2 + gf2dot p.1.tail xs) + gf2dot p.1.tail xs [MOD 2] :=
                  Nat.ModEq.add_right _ (Nat.mod_modEq _ 2)
              _ = p.2 + 2 * gf2dot p.1.tail xs := by ring
              _ ≡ p.2 + 0 [MOD 2] := Nat.ModEq.add_left _ (by simp [Nat.ModEq])
              _ = p.2 := by ring
          exact key
        exact gf2sat_of_elim p eqs _ hpsat hsat2

theorem gf2foldl_add (l : List Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) (c : Nat) :
    l.foldl (fun acc j => acc + f j) c = c + (l.map f).sum := by
  induction l generalizing c with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih => rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]; ring

theorem gf2sum_eq (x row : List Nat) :
    ((List.range x.length).map (fun j => row.getD j 0 * x.getD j 0)).sum = gf2dot row x := by
  induction x generalizing row with
  | nil => simp [gf2dot_nil_right]
  | cons x0 xs ih =>
    rw [List.length_cons, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
      List.map_map, gf2dot_cons]
    congr 1
    · rw [gf2getD_zero]
      simp
    · rw [← ih row.tail]
      congr 1
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro j _
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [gf2getD_succ]
      simp [gf2getD_succ]

theorem gf2foldl_eq (row x : List Nat) :
    (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + row.getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0
      = gf2dot row x := by
  rw [gf2foldl_add, Nat.zero_add, gf2sum_eq]

theorem gf2mem_zip (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat)
    (hlen : matrix.length = b.length) (i : Nat) (hi : i < matrix.length) :
    (matrix.getD i [], b.getD i 0) ∈ matrix.zip b := by
  have hib : i < b.length := by omega
  have h1 : i < (matrix.zip b).length := by
    rw [List.length_zip]; omega
  have h2 : (matrix.zip b)[i] = (matrix[i], b[i]) := by
    simp [List.getElem_zip]
  have h3 : (matrix.getD i [], b.getD i 0) = (matrix.zip b)[i] := by
    rw [h2, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hib]
  rw [h3]
  exact List.getElem_mem h1
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond_satisfied (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) :
    solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond matrix b (solve_linear_system_gf2 matrix b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hm, hn, hlen, -, -, hrows, hbvals⟩ := h_precond
  have hspec := gf2go_spec (matrix.getD 0 []).length (matrix.zip b)
  show match gf2go (matrix.getD 0 []).length (matrix.zip b) with
    | some x => is_solution matrix b x
    | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length →
        (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  have hbmod : ∀ i, i < matrix.length → b.getD i 0 % 2 = b.getD i 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hib : i < b.length := by omega
    have : b.getD i 0 ∈ b := by
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hib]
      exact List.getElem_mem hib
    rcases hbvals _ this with h | h <;> rw [h]
  cases hgo : gf2go (matrix.getD 0 []).length (matrix.zip b) with
  | some x =>
    rw [hgo] at hspec
    obtain ⟨hxlen, hs⟩ := hspec
    refine ⟨hxlen, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rw [gf2foldl_eq]
    have h1 := hs _ (gf2mem_zip matrix b hlen i hi)
    rw [h1, hbmod i hi]
  | none =>
    rw [hgo] at hspec
    intro x hxlen _ hsol
    refine hspec x hxlen ?_
    intro e he
    rw [List.mem_iff_getElem] at he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hei⟩ := he
    rw [List.length_zip] at hi
    have him : i < matrix.length := by omega
    have hib : i < b.length := by omega
    have h2 : (matrix.zip b)[i] = (matrix[i], b[i]) := by
      simp [List.getElem_zip]
    rw [h2] at hei
    subst hei
    have h3 := hsol.2 i him
    rw [gf2foldl_eq] at h3
    rw [← List.getD_eq_getElem matrix [] him, ← List.getD_eq_getElem b 0 hib]
    rw [h3, hbmod i him]
  -- !benchmark @end proof
